The person behind the projects

Always asking
“What if?”

I like pulling a problem apart, trying a few approaches, and making something people can actually use.

I'm a senior at West Windsor-Plainsboro High School South, Class of 2027. My interests span computer science, cybersecurity, AI, and business.

That curiosity has taken me from hardening Windows systems in CyberPatriot to studying cyber operations at MIT Beaver Works Summer Institute. Outside of code, I tutor, volunteer, and help lead student discussions through Dialogues Club.
